entities.name: UEInformationRequest message
entities.description: RRC message sent by the network to request UE information such as measurement reports, RLF reports, and mobility history.

entities.name: UEInformationResponse message
entities.description: RRC message sent by the UE in response to UEInformationRequest, containing requested information elements.

entities.name: VarMeasIdleReport
entities.description: UE variable storing idle mode measurement reports for EUTRA and NR cells.

entities.name: VarLogMeasReport
entities.description: UE variable storing logged measurement reports including timestamp, trace references, and measurement information.

entities.name: VarRA-Report
entities.description: UE variable storing random access related information reports.

entities.name: VarRLF-Report
entities.description: UE variable storing radio link failure and handover failure information.

entities.name: VarConnEstFailReport
entities.description: UE variable storing connection establishment and resume failure information.

entities.name: VarMobilityHistoryReport
entities.description: UE variable storing mobility history including visited cell information and time spent.

entities.name: VarSuccessHO-Report
entities.description: UE variable storing successful handover reports including interruption time measurements.

entities.name: Successful security activation
entities.description: Precondition that must be met before the UE processes the UEInformationRequest message.

entities.name: RPLMN included in plmn-IdentityList
entities.description: Condition requiring that the RPLMN is present in the stored PLMN identity list for various report types.

relations.description: UEInformationRequest processing requires successful security activation
UEInformationResponse contains measurement results from VarMeasIdleReport
UEInformationResponse contains logged measurement report from VarLogMeasReport
UEInformationResponse contains random access report from VarRA-Report
UEInformationResponse contains RLF report from VarRLF-Report
UEInformationResponse contains connection establishment failure report from VarConnEstFailReport
UEInformationResponse contains mobility history report from VarMobilityHistoryReport
UEInformationResponse contains successful handover report from VarSuccessHO-Report
Inclusion of idle measurement results is guarded by RPLMN condition
Inclusion of logged measurement report is guarded by RPLMN condition
Inclusion of random access report is guarded by RPLMN condition
Inclusion of RLF report is guarded by RPLMN condition
Inclusion of successful handover report is guarded by RPLMN condition
